welcome.line1: Welcome to Knowledge Management / Knowledge Base Chat.
welcome.line2: This is not a general chatbot — it serves as an experiment assistant for experiment design, knowledge base docs, historical experiments, and runtime anomalies.
welcome.line3: You can ask: why is the current step designed this way, how to choose a technique, what experience exists from similar runs, what variable to change next.

fallback.header: Backend knowledge retrieval is currently unavailable. Using fallback knowledge flow.
fallback.description: I’ll organize your question by: knowledge base / historical experiments / method experience / experiment context.
fallback.footer: Once real retrieval is connected, source citations, similar experiments, and clearer execution suggestions will appear.

cv.header: Fallback result: you asked about electrochemical technique / parameter selection.
cv.line1: • For initial screening, start with CV to quickly assess redox behavior and potential window.
cv.line2: • If you care about interface processes or charge transfer, follow up with EIS.
cv.line3: • Start with a scan rate of 50 mV/s; lower to 10–20 mV/s for weak signals or more detail.
cv.line4: • Next, you should specify sample type, target signal, and last successful experiment.

transfer.header: Fallback result: you asked about experiment execution errors.
transfer.check1: 1. Pump address / direction / channel mapping correctness;
transfer.check2: 2. RPM, volume mode, duration mode matching the current step;
transfer.check3: 3. Whether the current run is blocked by a previous step’s resource lock;
transfer.check4: 4. Recent logs for timeout, busy, or connection reset errors.
transfer.footer: If you’d like, paste the step parameters next and I’ll walk through the debugging sequence.

nextRound.header: Fallback result: you asked about next-round experiment design.
nextRound.line1: Change only one variable at a time to keep conclusions clear.
nextRound.priority1: 1. Core technique parameters (e.g., scan rate / potential range);
nextRound.footer: When real agents are connected, structured suggestion cards and historical run comparisons will appear.

history.header: Fallback result: you asked about historical experiment experience.
history.line1: Currently showing placeholder: similar experiment lists, key parameters, result summaries, and failure reasons will appear here.
history.line2: Please specify: target analyte, technique, anomaly observed, and your key evaluation criteria.
